    var boxWidth = $(".slider").width();
    var divElement = $(".filters-category");
    var divWidth = divElement.width();
    var speed = boxWidth - 100
    var position = divElement.position();
    var initleft = position.left;
    var initoffsetleft = divElement.offset().left;
    function moveLeft() {
        var nowposition = divElement.position();
        var nowleft = nowposition.left;
        var movedata = nowleft - speed;
        if(divWidth + initleft + movedata < speed){
            movedata = boxWidth-divWidth;
        }
        divElement.css("transform", "translateX("+movedata+"px)");
    }
    function moveRight() {
        var nowposition = divElement.position();
        var nowleft = nowposition.left;
        var movedata = nowleft + speed;
        if(movedata > initleft){
            movedata = 0;
        }
        divElement.css("transform", "translateX("+movedata+"px)");
    }

    const swipeElement = document.getElementById('slider');
    let startX, startY;
    swipeElement.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
        startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
        startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    });
    swipeElement.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
    });
    swipeElement.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
        const endX = e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
        const endY = e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
        const deltaX = endX - startX;
        const SWIPE_THRESHOLD = 30;
        if (Math.abs(deltaX) > SWIPE_THRESHOLD) {
            if (deltaX > 0) {
                moveRight();
            } else {
                moveLeft();
            }
        }
    });
